caption_L1: This is a bar graph titled Number of Starbucks stores in China from 2005 to 2019. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 1,400 can be seen on the x-axis, labeled licensed stores. Along the y-axis, Year is shown.
caption_L2L3: The graph shows that Starbucks had a slow start at expanding in china for the first 5 years but has consistently expanded since 2013. In 2017 there were at least 6 times as many Starbucks as there were in 2005.
